Sample Descriptive Statistics

In this file, we’ll import all of the Dallas County files provided and create preliminary cross-tabulations and merges to explore basic counts, trends, and double check primary keys and joins across the data files.

See Codebooks and Data Diagram tabs for more information on each individual data file.

Proposed hierarchy (most to least serious) for keeping most serious disposed offense per referral:

Are these correct? Do we want to rank within violent, property? How do we want to rank CINS?

1. Felony:

  • Violent (Homicide, Sexual Assault, Assaultive, Weapons Offenses, Robbery, Other Violent)

  • Property (Burglary, Theft, Other Property)

  • Non-Person Drug (Drug Offenses)

  • Other Felony (Other Felony)

2. Misdemeanor:

  • Violent (Assaultive, Weapons Offenses)

  • Property (Theft, Other Property)
